North Central.description: One of Regina's oldest neighbourhoods with strong community roots. Higher crime rates due to poverty and addiction issues. Active community organizations working on revitalization. Very affordable housing.
North Central.best_for: Budget-conscious residents who value community programs
North Central.watch_out: Property crime, avoid walking alone at night in some areas

Cathedral.description: Regina's most walkable neighbourhood. Independent shops, cafes, character homes. Mix of young professionals and families. Some property crime but generally safe on main streets.
Cathedral.best_for: Young professionals, artists, people who hate driving
Cathedral.watch_out: Vehicle break-ins, some noise from bars on 13th Ave

Harbour Landing.description: Regina's newest neighbourhood on the south side. Modern homes, big box stores, new schools being built. Very car-dependent but growing rapidly with young families. Low crime due to newness.
Harbour Landing.best_for: Young families wanting new builds, people who don't mind driving
Harbour Landing.watch_out: Limited transit, construction noise, few established trees

Lakeview.description: Mature trees, winding streets, and solid 1960s-70s homes near Wascana Lake. Quiet and safe with good schools nearby. Walking distance to Wascana Park trails.
Lakeview.best_for: Families, retirees, nature lovers who want city convenience
Lakeview.watch_out: Garage break-ins, older homes may need updates

University Park.description: Adjacent to the University of Regina campus. Mix of students and established families. Good access to campus facilities, indoor pools, and athletic trails. Very safe overall.
University Park.best_for: Students, university staff, families near campus amenities
University Park.watch_out: Vehicle thefts in parking areas, limited nightlife

Normanview West.description: Small, tucked-away neighbourhood on the west side. Mostly single-family homes from the 1970s-80s. Very low crime, good for families who want peace and quiet. Limited walkable amenities.
Normanview West.best_for: Families wanting affordable, safe, quiet streets

Albert Park.description: Centered around Albert Street's commercial strip. Mix of retail, fast food, and residential. Higher crime stats partly due to shoplifting at stores. Affordable with good bus access.
Albert Park.best_for: People needing transit access and nearby shopping
Albert Park.watch_out: Shoplifting inflates crime numbers, vehicle theft in parking lots

Walsh Acres.description: Popular northwest neighbourhood with good schools, parks, and the Normanview Mall nearby. Mix of 1980s-90s homes. Safe, well-maintained, with strong community feel.
Walsh Acres.best_for: Families with school-age kids, people wanting suburban comfort
Walsh Acres.watch_out: Some retail crime near mall area, otherwise very safe

Coronation Park.description: Northeast neighbourhood with a mix of older homes and some newer infill. Close to industrial areas but has its own parks and schools. Affordable option with decent transit.
Coronation Park.best_for: Budget-minded families, people working in north-end industries
Coronation Park.watch_out: Higher property crime than average, some drug activity

Rosemont.description: Mid-city neighbourhood with easy access to downtown and major routes. Mix of older character homes and newer builds. Good parks and the Albert Library nearby. Moderate crime.
Rosemont.best_for: People wanting central location without downtown prices
Rosemont.watch_out: Garage break-ins, vehicle theft, some assault near bars

Hillsdale.description: Mature neighbourhood near Broad Street with good schools and shopping. Mix of 1960s-70s homes. Stable crime rates, well-connected by bus to downtown.
Hillsdale.best_for: Families wanting established area with good infrastructure

Gardiner Park.description: East Regina neighbourhood anchored by Victoria Square Mall. Good mix of shopping, schools, and parks. Crime stats partly inflated by retail theft. Solid family area away from mall.
Gardiner Park.best_for: Families who want shopping convenience on the east side
Gardiner Park.watch_out: Shoplifting skews stats, some vehicle theft near mall

Whitmore Park.description: Southwest neighbourhood with some of Regina's lowest crime rates. Quiet residential streets, good schools, close to Wascana trails. Mostly 1970s-80s homes in good condition.
Whitmore Park.best_for: Safety-conscious families, retirees, newcomers wanting low-risk area
Whitmore Park.watch_out: Car-dependent, limited nightlife or walkable dining

Eastview.description: East side neighbourhood near industrial areas. Affordable housing, some newer developments. Crime is decreasing year over year. Good highway access for commuters.
Eastview.best_for: Commuters, budget-conscious people comfortable with industrial neighbours
Eastview.watch_out: Break and enters (business), some drug activity

Dieppe.description: Small residential area in the northeast with low crime and family-friendly streets. Older homes but well-maintained. Close to parks and schools. Often overlooked by newcomers.
Dieppe.best_for: Families wanting affordable, safe, quiet living

Sherwood Estates.description: One of Regina's more affluent areas in the north. Larger lots, newer homes, very low crime. Close to Wascana and the Legislative grounds via Broad Street. Quiet and private.
Sherwood Estates.best_for: Professionals wanting larger homes in a safe area
Sherwood Estates.watch_out: Vehicle theft, property crime targeting garages

Twin Lakes.description: Southern neighbourhood near the Lewvan Drive corridor. Mix of 1980s-90s homes with some newer builds. Family parks, a man-made lake feature, and decent schools nearby.
Twin Lakes.best_for: Families with kids, people who like green space
Twin Lakes.watch_out: Some vehicle theft, mischief near parks

Prairie View.description: Quiet southwest area with mostly residential streets. Mix of older and newer homes. Low crime, good parks, but limited transit. Popular with families wanting space without high costs.
Prairie View.best_for: Families wanting safe, affordable southwest living
Prairie View.watch_out: Break-ins to residences, limited bus service

Boothill.description: Compact east-side neighbourhood that flies under the radar. Older homes, affordable rents, and improving crime stats. Close to parks and schools. Good starter neighbourhood.
Boothill.best_for: First-time renters, newcomers on a budget
Boothill.watch_out: Garage break-ins, vehicle theft from autos

Regent Park.description: Small east-side neighbourhood with a mix of older homes. Crime is decreasing and the area is stable. Close to parks and some schools. Affordable and quiet.
Regent Park.best_for: People wanting quiet, affordable east-side living
Regent Park.watch_out: Some assault incidents, limited nighttime activity
